column3: Kuroneko Route · Swirly Glasses' Words
Well then, first of all...
I'm counting on you, Saori!
So it's about Kuroneko-shi's situation...
Yeah, do you happen to know anything?
Let's see... I heard she's busy working on her manuscript for the upcoming Summer Comiket.
And that's why there won't be any contact for a while.
I see, working on her manuscript for Summer Comiket, huh.
Every year, many circle participants lose sleep just to finish their work in time for this event.
Surely, it's the final stage of preparations.
I see...
No wonder Kirino doesn't understand, she never joined a circle to participate before...
However, after hearing from you, it appears that that's not the case.
You think so too?
However, that's about all I can say so far.
I'd also like to help Kuroneko-shi with her endeavor, but...
I too, am very busy. Please accept my deepest apologies...
Are you also bothered by something?
N-No! I-It's just the so-called 'family matters'.
I see... then is there anything I can help with?
It's all right. Please help Kuroneko-shi instead.
Got it, leave it to me.
You have my gratitude, Kyousuke-shi.
Given Saori's personality, it must be rough on her if she's unable to do anything when something happens to her friends... Compared to others, she
really treasures her friends.
Myself, I hate when all I can do is show concern... And yet...
Nonetheless, I can't ask her to do more...
Don't worry about it. You have to put yourself first.
It lightens my mood a bit to hear you say that.
Now that I think about it, isn't Kiririn-shi related to this matter?
She was feeling down about being ignored by Kuroneko.
To be honest, I asked Kirino for advice before coming to you.
Preposterous, you asking Kiririn-shi?
Yes, I asked her if I was being overly considerate and now Kuroneko thinks I'm creepy or something like that.
But, from what she said, Kuroneko doesn't mind that at all. That's why she ordered me to resolve it myself.
I see, I see. I understand.
Then, there is only one conclusion.
Right, that thing Kirino mentioned, I might as well ask Saori about it too.
Say, do you know anything about Kuroneko and any important goal she might have?
Well! I don't really...
I see, I thought so...
Kyousuke-shi... Who told you about this "important goal"?
It was Kirino...
I see, I see. So that's how it is.
What's the matter? Do you happen to know something?
Not at all. Just that, did those words stick to your mind?
Y-Yeah... well, kind of.
Huhuhu...
What's with her weird laughter?
These matured brain cells of mine are telling me that it would be best to let you handle this situation by yourself.
Eh?
Seeing as I cannot partake in this, all I can do is make wild guesses.
Oh, well, I guess so...
Then remain as you are and go all out with a bang!
...I'm sure Kuroneko-shi will be delighted if you put your step forward.
I don't get it.
We'll leave it at here for now. Let's talk about something else.
But regarding Kuroneko...
Now now, maybe you'll agree after listening.
While it is true that I have stuff to do, I promised Kuroneko-shi to meet her tomorrow.
Oh? What for?
We're going to buy art supplies for preparing doujinshi to be sold at Comiket.
It would be problematic if you ran out later, so how about going together? is what I told her.
Ahah...
As expected from Saori.
In that case, allow me to go along with you.
This could be a chance for me to speak with Kuroneko.
Hehehe, I thought you'd say that.
Then...
Yeah, we would love to have you. We'll meet at Akihabara tomorrow then?
Yeah! Thanks a lot!
Don't mention it, I'll create the opportunity for you two to talk, so when that happens...
No need to say more! I'll try and make the most use out of it!
You must do your best, Kyousuke-shi, good fortune to you!
...All right. Tomorrow is the showdown!
